name: Kagayaki Makoto
source:
A cheerful, energetic and talented idol. Although she's rather clumsy, she has a brighter and more positive personality than everyone else in the group. Her outfit is a classic idol look, but with a cute hat to help her stand out!
[Translated from [url=https://cream-nohana.fanbox.cc/posts/8667943]Fanbox[/url]]
